topic: Day 119 — reel — Your value doesn't fluctuate with your output, even though your mood does
text:
A slow week
makes the
week slow.
Not [you].
caption:
Tying worth to output turns a normal dip into a verdict on who you are. The mood drops; the value didn't move.

Follow for one of these a day.
